source_limits: Hailo source spectral CSV explicitly leaves precision and measurement_boundary unspecified. The M.2-card-input boundary follows the operator's project description; there is no independent boundary/calibration validation in the spectral table.
No Hailo-specific same-trace sampling-rate threshold is inferred from these PSD percentiles.
The Hailo 10-s prefix and Jetson 10-s middle-of-load PSD use different estimators and are described separately.
No raw-waveform integration, resampling, recalibration or re-selection of the frozen 13-run reference cohort was performed in this manuscript update.
